name: Demons and You
summary: A library keeper asks you to add a magical work to the collection. Your efforts help expand the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: A Library Collection
sections.body: A keeper at the Library in Ironforge asks you to contribute a magical work. The collection grows through your efforts, and the keeper welcomes further works that could benefit the library.

faq.q: What does the library keeper want?
faq.answer: The keeper asks you to bring a magical work to add to the library’s collection.
The collection is in the Library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why bring magical works to the library?
faq.answer: The keeper says your efforts expand the library’s knowledge.
